summary.text: Duke Tucker is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 75 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Keith Mogel.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as operations manager.

paragraphs.text: Duke Tucker was born in St. Croix Falls, Wisconsin, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1989 to 1992.
His career experience includes working as an operations manager.
Tucker took office in the Assembly in January 2025, succeeding David Armstrong.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Agriculture, Environment (vice-chair), Sporting Heritage, and Veterans and Military Affairs.
